purpose: Admin shell with navigation for the asset/category operations console.
businessRules: Keep admin navigation focused on internal DAM, taxonomy, and review operations, not customer-facing marketing or frontend-only copy controls.
Admin shell spacing, icons, and navigation labels must keep asset, category, and review operations readable on narrow and wide screens.
On mobile and tablet widths, admin navigation must scroll within its own rail and must never increase page-level width; phone tabs hide secondary descriptions so labels remain readable.
Navigation descriptions use operator-friendly labels such as details and fields instead of casual implementation jargon.
Do not load customer storefront datasets in the admin layout.
Future admin sections should join this shell without leaking server-only secrets to the browser.
